title: Prime Minister shares an article by Shri Swapan Dasgupta highlighting how PM Modi has recrafted India’s story by dissolving the old world of binaries
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has shared an article written by Shri Swapan Dasgupta. In the article, Shri Swapan Dasgupta writes that the Prime Minister has recrafted India's story by dissolving the old world of binaries. It highlights how reforms and welfare, cultural pride and technology have been brought together, with targeted welfare delivery and digital platforms working alongside economic reforms. The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X: “Shri @swapan55 writes that PM @narendramodi has recrafted India's story by dissolving the old world of binaries. He highlights how reforms and welfare, cultural pride and technology have been brought together, with targeted welfare delivery and digital platforms working alongside economic reforms. Do read this thoughtful piece.”
